{{Top|leg}}
The [[Jinda/Legends|Jinda]] known as [[Chituhr]] performed a circus act on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] by juggling several creatures known as ferrets, with the announcer refereing to them as flying ferrets.<ref name="1-07">{{Ewoks|The Curse of the Jindas}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==

A real ferret was used to depict a [[Unidentified mammalian Endorian creature|creature]] for a scene in ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]'', but since the name of the creature's species was not mentioned in the film or in official reference materials, it is unclear if it it intended to be the same species as the ferrets from "[[The Curse of the Jindas]]".
